name: Mindful Walking with Paced Breathing

instructions.description: Begin walking at an easy pace in a clear area.
Notice the contact of each foot with the ground.
Allow breathing to settle into a natural rhythm with the steps.
Keep attention on movement and surroundings without forcing a fixed count.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record a comfortable breathing rate without prescribing a universal norm.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

commentsNotes: Keep the pace easy and breathing natural.

variations.variationDescription: Mindful Walking with Paced Breathing — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.
